name: 270. A request cannot finish another caller's log row by reusing its request ID (log-row-ownership) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-5522 security regression. Local fixture regression: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. x-request-id is caller-supplied. One key logs a visible row; a second key with content logging off then sends two overlapping calls under the same ID, so the second to finish has no pending entry and looks for a row with its ID. It must leave a row that is not its own unfinished partial alone. Before the fix it reconciled onto the owner's row, took over its key and hid it.
